title: Optimizing solvent systems for electrospun PLGA scaffolds: effects on microstructure and mechanical properties for biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3259-3272
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07881K, Paper
Open Access

Golestan Salimbeigi, Garrett B. McGuinness
Optimizing solvent systems for electrospun PLGA tissue scaffolds enables control over mechanical properties. Hansen solubility theory helps identify key solvent effects, enabling the design of tunable, high-performance scaffolds for biomedical use.
